problem_type: Temporary model upload loses decoder identity
symptom: Uploading FBX in the browser creates a fallback box and reports Kaydara FB is not valid JSON.
direct_cause: The temporary upload path replaces the filename with an extensionless blob URL; both model and character renderers choose FBX versus GLTF by the modelPath suffix.
class_root: The asset-address creation boundary discards format identity required by downstream decoders.
affected_population: Browser/devlab temporary FBX uploads; all temporary model uploads pass this boundary
entry_points: CharacterEntity FBX/GLTF routing after Mixamo detection
internal_only_reason: Existing decoders work; the internal upload path loses the filename they already require.
invariants: A temporary binary model URL retains its original filename for decoder selection
Stored desktop assets continue to use their existing durable URLs
generality_proof: All temporary binary asset uploads preserve their original name in the URL fragment; both existing model consumers read the same modelPath without decoder-specific fallback.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Create temporary binary asset addresses with original format identity

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses modelPath created by uploadFiles; real FBX walk fails before fix and decodes after.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: FBX character branch after ModelEntity Mixamo upgrade
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Keeps the same modelPath; walk checks actual bone extent after upgrade.
hostedAssetUrl already retains extension and is not rewritten.

recurrence.reason: Every temporary FBX upload loses its extension in the same branch.
same_class_scan: Read uploadFiles URL creation for all supported binary kinds
Read shared isFbxUrl and both ModelEntity/CharacterEntity call sites
Ran real FBX decoder red case; GLB is alternate format class test

prevention.invariant: Temporary model identity survives address generation.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported files remain rejected at existing asset-kind validation.
prevention.strategy: Preserve encoded original filename on the temporary address at creation.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace extensionless temporary URL creation in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No decoder API change; restores data required by existing application routing.

migration: Durable assets unchanged. Existing expired temporary blob addresses require re-upload as already disclosed in the UI.
residual_risks: Temporary uploads still expire when their owning browser document closes; the UI explicitly says to re-upload.
External-resource .gltf packages have not been validated in this isolated walk.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/panels/side/AssetsTab.tsx 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
